neighbours.label: Spelling unit: the 'ce'-initial word piece directly after an en-/em- prefix (en|ceph|al-, em|cee, em|ceed, Enc|eladus), regardless of meaning; not 'ceph' without en-, not en-/em- words without a ce- piece
